scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint:fix
scripts.update:doc: npm run gitclean && git-cliff > CHANGELOG.md && typedoc --options typedoc.json && git add --all && git commit -S -am "doc: update api documentation" && git commit -am "doc: update CHANGELOG" && npm run build:doc -w website
scripts.release:major: npm run gitclean && npm run release:prepare && npm run gitclean && npm version major --no-git-tag-version --workspaces && npm run commit:major && npm publish --workspaces
scripts.release:minor: npm run gitclean && npm run release:prepare && npm run gitclean && npm version minor --no-git-tag-version --workspaces && npm run commit:minor && npm publish --workspaces
scripts.release:patch: npm run gitclean && npm run release:prepare && npm run gitclean && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version --workspaces && npm run commit:patch && npm publish --workspaces
scripts.release:prepare: npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.tag: git push && git push --tags && rm -rf build/temp
scripts.commit:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && scripts/commitVersion.sh && npm run build
scripts.commit:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && scripts/commitVersion.sh && npm run build
scripts.commit:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && scripts/commitVersion.sh && npm run build
scripts.build:doc: git-cliff > CHANGELOG.md && typedoc --options typedoc.json && npm run build:doc -w website
